trust_boundary: configure(AIR) fixes canonical AIR and compiler semantics outside the per-proof verifier; proof cannot supply configuration
dependency_chain: Canonical static AIR plus fixed compiler identifier -> trusted configuration digest.
Configuration digest plus fixed-width public values and all table shapes/packings -> statement digest.
Statement digest plus ordered source roots -> alpha/gamma; all auxiliary roots and finals precede every zerocheck challenge.
All zerocheck coefficient vectors are committed in table/round order. Fresh rho is drawn only after their completion.
Canonical compiler deterministically derives circuit topology, all public constants and input-slot mapping from the above values. No proof-selected layout is accepted.
GKR initialization binds fixed compiler configuration, pre-GKR transcript binding and output claim. Every sumcheck polynomial and pair of input claims is absorbed before the next challenge.
Final GKR transcript seed binds its complete message history. Final input query points, batching scalar, public-constant subtraction and aggregate private claim are verifier-derived.

Current/next input-slot weights map deterministically through upper-zeta and cyclic-shift row functionals to per-lane coefficient weights. Source/aux order and public row points come from the fixed statement and verified zerochecks.
Weighted PCS initialization binds statement, pre/final GKR seed, fixed-width root/shape/rowpoint metadata and aggregate claim. It omits only lane arrays already fixed by the dependency chain.
Complete verifier invokes weighted PCS and global randomized bus fingerprint product equality. No residual opening obligation is returned as acceptance.
required_assumptions: Framed SHA384 statement/transcript binding; no QROM reduction is supplied
Canonical compiler/evaluation/weight-map correspondence, tested but not fully formally composed
Sumcheck/GKR/batching algebraic soundness bounds and correlated virtual-oracle/proximity/RBR security remain to be established
Natural bus balance only outside fingerprint collision and zero-factor bad events
Q8/Ext4 remains a diagnostic parameter set
non_goals: No standalone arbitrary-weight PCS security claim under omitted-weight hashing
No proof of the complete recursive verifier
